Maple Street Tool Library: lending rules
Agreed at the March committee meeting.

Loan lengths
  Hand tools (hammers, saws, spanners, spirit levels): 7 days.
  Power tools, corded or battery (drills, sanders, jigsaws): 3 days.
  Ladders and steps: 2 days.

Heavy machines (cement mixer, pressure washer, tile cutter)
  The committee has not agreed a loan length yet. It is choosing between a weekend
  (Friday to Monday) and 3 days. Until then, heavy machines are lent only by
  arrangement at the desk.

Late returns
  50p a day per item. The fee is waived if the borrower rings before the due date.

Renewals
  One renewal of the same length, if nobody else has asked for the item.
